name: Vertiv Liebert CW181 chilled-water CRAH
description: Perimeter chilled-water computer room air handler, downflow, 3 EC plug fans, 6-row coil. Suited to the residual air load of liquid-cooled AI halls with warm water.

capacity_w.note: 210 kW total = sensible, high delta-T rating: 85 F DB / 64.4 F WB return air (29.4 C), 50 F in / 64 F out water (10->17.8 C), 108 GPM. At 90 F return air: 246 kW; at classic 75 F / 45 F water: 211 kW total, 179 kW sensible

power_w.note: 3 EC fans x 4.9 hp (3.7 kW) maximum motor rating; absorbed power at rated airflow not published

airflow_m3_s.note: nominal 24,000 CFM (40,800 m3/h) at 0.2 in w.c. (50 Pa) ESP

weight_kg.note: unit weight 2900 lb; 3200 lb (1450 kg) shipping

sources.title: Vertiv Liebert CW System Design Catalog, CW038-CW181, 60 Hz (2024)
